evals.prompt: Show me different directions for the Trip page (src/app/trip/page.tsx). Goal: help a commuter see in two seconds whether tonight's connection is at risk.
evals.expected_output: The agent restates the brief in one sentence, reads the product's tokens and real content, writes system.md in a run folder (design-runs/directions-<screen>-<date>/ by default), declares one axis and three bets in run.json with direction 1 extending today's design, and sends one subagent per direction (or builds them one after another if subagents are unavailable). Each direction is a self-contained index.html in its own folder that opens offline. The agent checks each direction, builds board.html with build-board.mjs, and returns the summary (board path, axis, one line per direction with its bet and cost, issues) without ranking. Project source stays untouched.
assertions: Exactly 3 directions are produced, each in its own folder with an index.html
The bets are written down before any direction is built, and direction 1 keeps the current Trip page's patterns
No direction's index.html loads anything from an outside URL (no CDN, framework or web font links)
The summary describes each direction's bet and cost without ranking them or naming a favorite

evals.prompt: explore this page before we build: the empty dashboard new teams see. goal is getting them to invite a teammate. 4 directions, density axis
evals.expected_output: The agent builds four directions spread along the density axis, collects them on one board.html, and writes only inside the run folder.
assertions: Four directions are built, spread from calm to dense
A board.html file is produced that contains every direction
No file in the project's source tree is modified

evals.prompt: Show me 8 different directions for the pricing page. Goal: make the yearly plans easier to compare.
evals.expected_output: The skill builds 3 directions by default and 5 at most. The agent caps the run at 5 directions (or asks whether 5 is acceptable) and says why, instead of building 8.
assertions: No more than 5 directions are planned or built
The response tells the user the run is capped at 5 directions
No extra review or scoring agents are started beyond one per direction
